question: Internet Archive states three different file ceilings for one item: 1,000 files or 500 GB recommended per item, 500 files or 500 GB in the bulk-upload guidance, and 10,000 files with the API accepting 250,000. Which is enforced?
why: a plan built on the 1 TB item limit has to know whether 500 or 10,000 files is the working ceiling; only a large upload on an account would settle it, which a research lane cannot do
